goal.en: Check in on your first day, meet your coworker Sam, and find out who to ask about what.
goal.zh: 第一天上班報到，認識同事山姆，搞清楚什麼事該問誰。

background: bright modern office reception area with a wooden front desk, pendant lights in different shapes, potted plants, glass entrance doors, soft morning sunlight, polished concrete floor

intro.en: Monday, 8:50 a.m. Your first day at Brightway. You take a deep breath and push open the glass door.
intro.zh: 星期一早上八點五十分，Brightway 上班第一天。你深吸一口氣，推開玻璃門。

intro.en: A woman with a pen behind her ear looks up from the front desk.
intro.zh: 一位耳朵上夾著筆的女士從櫃檯後抬起頭。

lines.en: Good morning! Welcome to Brightway. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 早安！歡迎來到 Brightway，有什麼需要幫忙的嗎？

choices.en: Hi, I'm Kai. It's my first day, and Ms. Wong asked me to come at nine.
choices.zh: 嗨，我是凱，今天第一天上班。王經理請我九點來報到。
choices.tip: 報到時先說名字，再說明是第一天上班、要找誰，對方馬上知道怎麼幫你。

choices.en: Hello! I come to report. Today I am a new person here.
choices.zh: 你好！我來報到，今天我是這裡的新人。

lines.en: Report? Report what? Did something happen in the parking lot?
lines.zh: 報告？報告什麼？停車場出了什麼事嗎？

story.en: Nina calls building security to take your "report." It takes twenty minutes to explain that you just work here now.
story.zh: 妮娜打電話請大樓警衛來聽你的「報告」。你花了二十分鐘才解釋清楚，你只是今天開始在這裡上班。

fail.why: report 是「報告、檢舉」，不是「報到」。第一天上班直接說 Hi, I'm Kai. It's my first day. 就好。

choices.en: Hi. Where's the toilet? I drank way too much coffee on the bus this morning.
choices.zh: 嗨，廁所在哪？我早上在公車上喝了太多咖啡。

lines.en: Oh, um, down the hall on the left. And you are...?
lines.zh: 喔，呃，走廊左手邊。請問你是……？

story.en: You rush off before answering. Nina thinks you're a delivery driver, and you wait in the lobby until ten before anyone finds you.
story.zh: 你沒回答就衝走了。妮娜以為你是送貨司機，你在大廳等到十點才有人來找你。

fail.why: 對方問 How can I help you? 是在等你說明身分和來意。先說 I'm Kai. It's my first day.，有其他需要再問。另外，北美多說 restroom，比 toilet 委婉。

lines.en: Nina makes a quick call. A minute later, a young man with a lanyard walks over.
lines.zh: 妮娜撥了一通電話。一分鐘後，一位掛著識別證的年輕男子走了過來。

lines.en: Hey, you must be Kai! I'm Sam. I'll be sitting right next to you.
lines.zh: 嘿，你一定是凱吧！我是山姆，我就坐你隔壁。

choices.en: It's nice to finally meet you, Sam. Ms. Wong said you'd show me around.
choices.zh: 終於見到你了，山姆，很高興認識你。王經理說你會帶我認識環境。
choices.tip: It's nice to finally meet you. 的 finally 表示「久聞其名，終於見面」，第一次見同事很好用。

choices.en: Nice to meet you! I very happy to work with you starting from today.
choices.zh: 很高興認識你！我很開心從今天開始和你一起工作。

lines.en: Ha, okay... you very happy? Cool, cool.

story.en: Sam smiles politely and starts the tour. All morning, you replay the sentence in your head, wishing you had added one tiny word.
story.zh: 山姆禮貌地笑笑，開始帶你參觀。整個早上，你在腦中一直重播那句話，後悔少說了一個小小的字。

fail.why: 中文的「我很開心」不需要動詞，但英文形容詞前面一定要有 be 動詞：I'm very happy to work with you.。

choices.en: Nice to meet you, Sam! So how old are you this year? Are you married yet?
choices.zh: 很高興認識你，山姆！你今年幾歲？結婚了沒？

lines.en: Uh... that's a little personal. How about we start with the office tour?
lines.zh: 呃……這有點私人耶。我們先從參觀辦公室開始好嗎？

story.en: Sam laughs it off, but for the rest of the week, he answers all your questions very, very briefly.
story.zh: 山姆笑笑帶過，但接下來一整個星期，他回答你的問題都非常、非常簡短。

fail.why: 台灣長輩常問年齡和婚姻表示關心，但在北美職場，第一次見面就問這些會讓人不自在。先說 It's nice to finally meet you.，聊工作或興趣就好。

lines.en: Okay, this is your desk, and the kitchen is over there. Any questions so far?
lines.zh: 好，這是你的座位，茶水間在那邊。目前為止有什麼問題嗎？

choices.en: Just one. Where can I find printer paper and other office supplies?
choices.zh: 只有一個。請問影印紙和其他文具在哪裡拿？
choices.tip: 問東西放在哪、去哪裡拿，用 Where can I find...? 最自然。

choices.en: Yes. Where can I take some paper and pens? I need many of them.
choices.zh: 有。我可以去哪裡拿一些紙跟筆？我需要很多。

lines.en: Take them... where? Like, home? They're for the office, Kai.
lines.zh: 拿去……哪裡？帶回家嗎？那些是辦公室用的耶，凱。

story.en: Sam is joking, mostly. But every time you walk past the supply cabinet this week, he whispers, "Don't take too much!"
story.zh: 山姆應該只是開玩笑。但這個星期你每次經過文具櫃，他都會小聲說：「別拿太多喔！」

fail.why: 中文「去哪裡拿」直譯成 take，聽起來像要把東西帶走。問東西放哪裡，說 Where can I find...? 或 Where can I get...?。

choices.en: No questions. I'm a fast learner, so I can figure everything out by myself.
choices.zh: 沒問題。我學很快，所有事情我都可以自己搞定。

story.en: Sam leaves you alone, as requested. You spend the next hour opening every cabinet in the office, looking for a stapler.
story.zh: 山姆如你所願讓你自己來。接下來一個小時，你把辦公室每個櫃子都打開了一遍，只為了找一台釘書機。

fail.why: 新人說「我自己搞定」聽起來有點自大，也會讓同事不好意思再幫你。第一天就大方問：Where can I find...?。

lines.en: I've got a meeting at ten. Anything else before I go?
lines.zh: 我十點有個會。我走之前還有其他問題嗎？

choices.en: Yes, who should I ask about my computer login? It isn't working yet.
choices.zh: 有，電腦登入的問題應該問誰？我還沒辦法登入。
choices.tip: Who should I ask about...? 問「這件事該找誰」，是新人最實用的一句。

choices.en: Yes, who I should ask about the computer? I can't log in to it yet.
choices.zh: 有，電腦的事我應該問誰？我還沒辦法登入。

lines.en: Who you should...? Sorry, I really have to run. Ask me later!
lines.zh: 你應該……誰？抱歉，我真的得走了，晚點再問我！

story.en: Sam hurries to his meeting before he figures out what you meant. You stare at the login screen until lunch.
story.zh: 山姆還沒搞懂你的意思就趕去開會了。你盯著登入畫面一直到中午。

fail.why: 疑問句要把助動詞放在主詞前面：Who should I ask?，不是 Who I should ask?。

choices.en: No, it's fine. I don't want to bother you. I'll just wait for someone to come.
choices.zh: 沒有，沒關係。我不想打擾你，我等別人來就好。

lines.en: Wait for who? Nobody will know you need help unless you ask.
lines.zh: 等誰？你不問的話，沒人會知道你需要幫忙啊。

story.en: Nobody comes. At noon, Ms. Wong stops by and asks why you haven't started your training videos.
story.zh: 結果沒有人來。中午王經理經過，問你為什麼還沒開始看培訓影片。

fail.why: 台灣新人常等別人主動來教，但在北美職場，有問題要自己開口問。說 Who should I ask about...? 一點都不算打擾。

lines.en: Oh, and lunch! A few of us go to the noodle place downstairs at noon. Want to join?
lines.zh: 對了，午餐！我們幾個中午會去樓下的麵店，要一起來嗎？

choices.en: I'd love to, thanks for asking! Should I meet you here at twelve?
choices.zh: 好啊，謝謝你約我！十二點在這裡集合嗎？
choices.tip: 接受邀約用 I'd love to.，再確認時間地點，熱情又周到。

choices.en: Sure, I'll go with you guys. I can eat everything, no problem!
choices.zh: 好啊，我跟你們去。我什麼都能吃，沒問題！

lines.en: Everything? The whole menu? Wow, okay, big eater!
lines.zh: 全部？整份菜單？哇，好喔，大胃王！

story.en: Sam tells the team the new hire "can eat everything." At lunch, they order you the giant bowl as a welcome challenge.
story.zh: 山姆跟大家說新人「什麼都吃得完」。午餐時，大家幫你點了超大碗當作歡迎挑戰。

fail.why: I can eat everything. 聽起來像「我能把全部吃光」。想說不挑食，要說 I can eat anything. 或 I'm not picky.。

choices.en: Sure! Does the company pay for lunch? Or does the senior person treat the new one?
choices.zh: 好啊！午餐是公司出錢嗎？還是前輩請新人？

lines.en: Ha... no, we each pay for our own. Is that a thing in Taiwan?
lines.zh: 哈……沒有耶，我們都各付各的。台灣是這樣嗎？

story.en: Sam laughs, but the nickname "Free Lunch Kai" follows you around the office for a whole week.
story.zh: 山姆笑了出來，但「白吃午餐的凱」這個綽號跟了你整整一個星期。

fail.why: 台灣常有前輩請新人吃飯的習慣，但北美同事一起吃午餐通常各付各的。直接說 I'd love to.，到時候自己付就好。

lines.en: Welcome to the team, Kai. You're going to do great here.
lines.zh: 歡迎加入團隊，凱。你在這裡一定會表現得很好。

lines.en: By the end of the day, you know where everything is, and who to ask about everything else.
lines.zh: 到了下班時間，你已經知道東西都放在哪裡，其他的事也知道該問誰。

story.en: You head home with a building pass, a working laptop, and a lunch buddy. Not bad for day one.
story.zh: 你帶著門禁卡、能用的筆電，還多了一個午餐夥伴回家。第一天，表現不錯。

notes.en: It's nice to finally meet you.
notes.zh: 終於見到你了，很高興認識你。
notes.explain: 之前透過 email 或別人聽說過對方，第一次見面時加 finally，表示期待已久。

example.en: It's nice to finally meet you. Ms. Wong told me a lot about you.
example.zh: 終於見到你了，王經理常提到你。

notes.explain: 問東西放在哪、去哪裡拿，比直譯的 Where can I take...? 自然，也適合問會議室、茶水間等地點。

example.en: Where can I find the meeting rooms?

notes.explain: 疑問句裡助動詞 should 要放在主詞 I 前面。說成 Who I should ask? 是常見錯誤。

example.en: Who should I ask about my building pass?

notes.explain: report 是「報告、檢舉」，不是「報到」。第一天上班說 It's my first day. 或 I'm starting work here today.。

example.en: Hi, I'm Kai. It's my first day here.
example.zh: 嗨，我是凱，今天第一天上班。

notes.en: Everyone pays for their own lunch.
notes.explain: 台灣常有前輩請新人吃飯的習慣，但在北美職場，同事一起吃午餐通常各付各的，除非對方主動說 It's on me.。

example.en: Lunch is on me today, to welcome you to the team.
example.zh: 今天午餐我請，歡迎你加入團隊。
